rules: Exact criterion text is preserved from the pinned pack.
No test PASS or criterion completion is claimed without a hosted observation for the corresponding candidate.
Published producer code/test inspection is not proof of import or execution on WP11.
Separate fixture stores never compose into a same-case human confirmation journey.
A real database or a real financial engine does not turn fake native/skill/model callbacks into native execution evidence.

tests: a reopened case admits a second principal and concurrent human edits preserve one commit and its receipt
asserts: Real local store is disposed and reopened with a new product-state provider.
A second real UI-admitted principal reads the same case content/version; the durable creation receipt retains André as principal.
An admitted third principal outside participants is denied.
Two distinct consumed human edit grants reach the real provider with identical expected case/storage versions: one ok and one conflict.
Exactly one edit receipt, exact retry equality, different digest under the same command identity conflicts, losing draft remains immutable and rebases only with a new human grant.
limits: Participant membership is a clearly identified host fixture transaction, not an end-user sharing UI.
No browser, native session, model or MCP parity assertion.

asserts: Real store reopen preserves draft/version; exact draft retry; replaced incarnation and malformed references are denied.
Native draft without a valid binding and a capability whose receipt authority is unavailable are denied.
An inaccessible operation suppresses the case even when its result components are empty.
limits: The original case-port fixture keeps one principal and uses constructed native-shaped objects; it is not native execution evidence.

asserts: Edit commit needs the snapshot intent fence; exact retry returns the receipt; changed content on the same command identity conflicts.
Listing suppresses denied membership or source authority.
limits: Concurrency is covered separately by case_lifecycle_concurrency.

asserts: The actual Decisions HTTP parser and human/UI authority reject an extra field and a foreign origin.
A real human-admitted edit commits case v2 and the list returns the revised objective.
limits: The withCase wrapper is a fixture; no rendered browser or native/MCP route is exercised.

asserts: Missing inventory/category, unsupported applicability, unavailable evidence, duplicate/unassigned components and incomplete seals fail closed.
Confirmed zero remains distinguishable from omitted/pending; hypothetical scenario totals remain conditioned.
limits: These are coverage/classification validators, not proofs of a full consumer journey or a financial formula.

tests: shared categories and supported N/A consume one real Planner contribution and retain the complete composed interval
coverage distinguishes omitted and null training from explicit zero and a later 40000 quote
asserts: Real WP03/WP05 fixture produces knownSubtotal 210000; shared classification is not counted twice; unsupported N/A and revoked evidence invalidate the certificate.
Derived missing-category versus component-unresolved distinguish omitted and null training.
Separate confirmed-training fixture produces 250000 and exact threshold 15000; zero-training fixture retains 55000.
No duplicate component/certificate is admitted.
limits: Four separate fixtures/stores do not demonstrate later confirmation in the same case.
The operations remain hypothetical: coverageState complete does not imply comparisonStatus complete or total available.
comparison.knownDifference uses the producer's scenario order/sign; the user savings convention must be checked by the actual criterion consumer.

tests: explicit human choice persists the producer result, survives reopen, and never applies the simulated Planner operations
asserts: Without confirmation recordChoice is denied; confirmation persists the actual composed producer result with 210000 subtotal, null total and missing training.
Reopen preserves ChoiceRecord, case version and one choice-recorded event.
Prepared changes/receipts remain empty and the official Planner snapshot does not change.
Retry is exact and changed rationale under the same operation identity conflicts.
limits: confirmChoice is a fixture callback, not the complete human/browser authority path.
The later mutation only edits the objective directly; it does not confirm training40000 or promote250000 in that case.

tests: human-confirmed conditional choice persists its C10 caveat and provenance
asserts: Real UI/human authority rejects forged context, foreign origin, revoked admission, changed alternative and reuse as an apply grant.
C08 persists principal, basisVersion, conditioned comparison, pending training and choice ledger event.
limits: Scenario/comparison amounts are fixture outputs; this file does not validate WP03 calculation or native output.

asserts: Versioned rule registration is fenced and idempotent; changed digest conflicts.
Conditioned metric remains unknown; compatible confirmed metric is evaluated; mismatched unit and revoked authority fail closed.
limits: Metric callback supplies a fixture value; the independent real-engine proof is coverage_composed.

asserts: Promotion requires proposal proof and snapshot fence; failure preserves the old case.
Success atomically writes alternative, scenario result, analysis-accepted ledger and outbox; retry preserves one result and rejects changed rationale.
limits: Native run, SkillLoadReceipt and contribution are seeded fixture records; not proof that a skill actually loaded.

asserts: Human acceptance writes the existing contribution's ledger event and outbox atomically.
limits: Acceptance is distinct from promotion, choice, procurement approval and application.

asserts: Persisted result/coverage is bound to exact case, principal, access, source and request; stale/changed/revoked bindings are rejected.
limits: No standalone result-store assertion proves semantic replay of nested calculations or an actual native call.

asserts: A human-approved prepared Dashboard domain command and its receipt commit together.
limits: This is not the required Planner-success/Procurement-refusal cross-domain case.

asserts: The actual Planner domain mutation and its case receipt commit atomically across surfaces.
limits: A single local atomic transaction does not establish a global cross-domain transaction.

tests: real prepared execution reconciles normal without repeating Planner effects
real prepared execution reconciles lost-response without repeating Planner effects
real prepared execution reconciles revoked without repeating Planner effects
asserts: Actual Planner f0 is42 after one execution; a lost transport response leaves domain effect committed and case receipt unresolved.
Current receipt is consulted on retry; effect count stays one, including after an unrelated case edit.
Revocation denies receipt access/retry while active; restoration allows authoritative reconciliation.
A second stale Planner command produces its conflict receipt without changing the successful effect.
limits: Both commands target Planner; this file does not establish Procurement refusal or pending procurement approval.
Producer/human review callbacks are fixture authorities, not an independent reviewer/native judgment.

tests: nested C17 calculations reopen through persisted canonical requests and replay every ancestor
asserts: Persisted canonical calculation requests and their parent sources are reopened and replayed by the actual producer path.
limits: Run outcome is pending; this mapping does not infer C17 from record freshness alone.

asserts: Verified bridge callback obtains operationIdentity from consumed host-native lease and stores an exact private capture.
Commit fence checks live binding, provider generation, revocation, run request, record identity and output digest; C08 atomically publishes provenance/run/output.
limits: Static inspection only. No native execution, loaded SkillLoadReceipt or acceptance observation is claimed here.
Source references are a consumption proposal, not a statement that these apps/CLI blobs were imported into WP11.

asserts: Published handoff reopens the parent-bound C08 receipt before re-evaluating candidates; HTTP allows historical retry.
Published tests assert repeated response equality, changed request conflict, current authority, source fences and stored choice history.
limits: No WP11 hosted run for these files is attached.
The dedicated parent replay test seeds its original C08 receipt directly; it does not independently prove a lost response after a real parent effect.
Needs T06 real consumer, identical authority/base/input and route/handler/result/version comparison over UI/native/MCP.
Needs destination refusal without a consumed grant and after revocation.
Needs actual native session/model/SkillLoadReceipt/binding/output witness and post-reload output consumption.
